network_enforcement: The release checker makes no network request. Its Lean replay delegates to check_validation.sh, whose Lean subprocesses use Bubblewrap --unshare-net and a read-only host root. This is deliberately warm-cache nonrelease evidence.
scope_boundary: Fail-closed reconciliation of current structured authority with the provisional validation receipt and a fresh narrow trust-level-zero Lean replay. It cannot supply dependency acceptance, graph migration, H0/R0 review, cold offline hermetic evidence, a complete TCB/SBOM, independent verification, a deterministic release bundle, or master acceptance.
